game.the_great_migration_body: A [[Hunting Season]] symbol is guaranteed to land during [[Stampede]] Reveals!
game.bonus_bullets_body: 3 bonus games loaded with [[Hunting Season]] symbols and [[Stampede]] Reveals!
game.locked_and_loaded_body: Aim straight at the max win of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times your bet!
game.freespins_khaki_quest_body: In this bonus game, there is a higher chance of landing [[Hunting Season]] symbols!
game.freespins_roaring_reign_body: In this bonus game, there is a Lion Bar that progressively fills with each low-paying symbol on a reel that is shot during a Hunt. When the Lion Bar has been filled up, a [[Stampede]] Reveal is guaranteed to be triggered!
game.freespins_zebrawl_body: In this bonus game, a [[Hunting Season]] symbol is guaranteed to land on every spin. In addition, there is a Lion Bar that progressively fills with each low-paying symbol on a reel that is shot during a Hunt. When the Lion Bar has been filled up, a [[Stampede]] Reveal is guaranteed to be triggered!
game.landing_additional_fs_symbols_body: Landing additional [[FS]] symbols at the same time during the bonus awards extra free spins.

external.about_the_game_desc_4: The bags are packed and it’s time to venture into the heart of the wilderness, where preparation is everything! Stalk your way through the vast savannas of [[Great Game Serengeti]], a 5-reel, 3-row game featuring paylines and a max win of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times your bet available in every game mode!
external.hunting_season_desc_1: When a [[Hunting Season]] symbol lands on the grid, a Hunt is triggered after all regular wins have been handled. One target is located above each reel. Five shots are fired from left to right that will either hit or miss the target.
external.hunting_season_desc_2: Any Animal symbols on the reels that are hit are transformed into Coin or Trap symbols. Animal symbols display between 1 and 4 stars, which determines the minimum currency revealed.
external.hunting_season_desc_3: 1 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Bronze Coins.
external.hunting_season_desc_4: 2 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Silver Coins
external.hunting_season_desc_5: 3 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Gold Coins.
external.hunting_season_desc_6: 4 Star Animal symbols transform into a Trap symbol with a minimum value equal to Gold Coins.
external.hunting_season_desc_7: All Coins are awarded as a multiple of your bet.
external.hunting_season_desc_8: Bronze Coins have the following starting values: [[0.2x, 0.4x, 0.6x, 0.8x, 1x]]
external.hunting_season_desc_9: Silver Coins have the following starting values: [[2x, 3x, 4x, 5x]]
external.hunting_season_desc_10: Gold Coins have the following starting values: [[10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x]]
external.hunting_season_desc_11: Diamond Coins have the following starting values: [[100x, 150x, 250x, 500x]]
external.hunting_season_desc_12: During a Hunt, when a 4 Star Animal symbol appears on a reel that is shot, that symbol will transform into a Trap symbol with a value. Trap symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Trap symbols and add the collected values to its existing Trap value. All collected symbols retain their original values when collected by a Trap symbol. Trap symbols activate top to bottom, left to right. The final win is the total value of all Coins and Trap symbols
external.hunting_season_desc_13: If there is a [[Wild]] symbol on a reel that has been shot, that [[Wild]] symbol receives a Multiplier value. After all Coins and Trap symbols have been collected, each [[Wild]] symbol with a Multiplier multiplies between 1 and 5 Coin and Trap symbols. [[Wild]] symbols with Multipliers activate top to bottom, left to right. [[Wild]] symbols with Multipliers can have the following Multiplicative Multipliers: [[x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20]].
external.hunting_season_desc_14: One [[Hunting Season]] symbol can appear on the grid at the same time.
external.stampede_desc_1: During a spin, there is a chance that a [[Stampede]] Reveal will be triggered before any symbols have landed on the grid. When a [[Stampede]] Reveal is triggered, a [[Hunting Season]] symbol is guaranteed to land and no low-paying symbols can land on the grid. When the new symbols have landed, any wins and the Hunt will be handled before the next spin.
external.bonus_game_khaki_quest_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 8 free spins by landing 3 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
external.bonus_game_khaki_quest_desc_2: This bonus game keeps the base game’s mechanics, with a higher chance of landing [[Hunting Season]] symbols.
external.bonus_game_roaring_reign_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
external.bonus_game_roaring_reign_desc_2: This bonus game keeps the base game’s mechanics and [[Stampede]] Reveals will not trigger randomly. Instead, they are awarded through the Lion Bar, which is located outside of the grid
external.bonus_game_roaring_reign_desc_3: For every low-paying symbol located on a reel that is hit during a Hunt, the Lion Bar increases by one step. When the Lion Bar has increased by 10 steps, a [[Stampede]] Reveal is guaranteed to be triggered during the following spin. When the [[Stampede]] Reveal has been triggered, the Lion Bar resets before the next free spin. Any Lion Bar progression exceeding the amount required to trigger a [[Stampede]] Reveal, will be added to the Lion Bar, once it has been reset.
external.hidden_epic_bonus_game_zebrawl_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
external.hidden_epic_bonus_game_zebrawl_desc_2: This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the [[ROARING REIGN]] bonus. In addition, a [[Hunting Season]] symbol is guaranteed to land on every spin.
external.hidden_epic_bonus_game_zebrawl_desc_3: [[FS]] symbols cannot land in this bonus.
external.special symbols_desc_1: [[FS]] and [[Hunting Season]] symbols cannot be on the grid at the same time
external.special symbols_desc_2: The [[Wild]] symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.
external.bonushunt_featurespins_desc: Each spin is 3 times more likely to trigger a bonus game!
external.hunting_season_featurespins_desc: Each spin guarantees that a [[Hunting Season]] symbol lands!
external.big_five_featurespins_desc: Each spin guarantees that a [[Stampede]] Reveal is triggered!
external.khaki_quest_featurespins_desc: 8 free spins with a higher chance of landing [[Hunting Season]] symbols!
external.roaring_reign_featurespins_desc: 10 free spins with a progressive Lion Bar that awards [[Stampede]] Reveals!
external.mod_feature_gameinfo_desc: The return to player when playing [[:bonus]] is [[:featurertp]]%. For full information about this feature, see the section above. [[FS]] symbols cannot land in this game mode.
external.maxwingermany_body: Maximum win: [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times the total stake. Probability of getting the maximum win: 1:[[:oddsofmaxwin]]. The maximum win occurs when multiple Animal symbols land on each reel at the same time, with a Hunting Season symbol triggering a Hunt, which will transform each Animal symbol that is hit into Coin or Trap symbols, which will reveal a total combined cash prize value of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] that is awarded as a multiple of the bet. The maximum win is the sum of all winning combinations when the reels are stationary, taking into account further winning opportunities such as bonus rounds and free spins. The maximum win can be achieved in the base game but is only possible with a lower probability, if bonus rounds are excluded.
